name: Shiva Special Architecture (30 min, before practice)
origin: Todd Murphy, Shiva software (new in Shiva; Murphy: not tested in laboratory experiments)
summary: Shorter use of Shiva's 'Special Architecture' session, finished about an hour before yoga, meditation, prayer or chanting: the amygdala signal on the left half of the ring and the hippocampal signal on the right half, both stepping back to front. Murphy states that after shorter sessions the after-effects resemble meditation or deeper prayer. He says the design 'has not been tested in laboratory experiments'.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed; do not meditate during the session; finish about 1 h before yoga, meditation, prayer or chanting.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The vendor: 'the hippocampal signal, applied over the right runs counterclockwise, but the amygdala signal, applied over the left hemisphere, is applied in the opposite direction'; the design 'has not been tested in laboratory experiments' (sdu_page.htm). Here the left coils carry the amygdala signal (O1 -> TP7 -> FT7 -> Fp1) and the right coils the hippocampal signal (O2 -> TP8 -> FT8 -> Fp2). That both play at once is this project's reading: the page does not say whether they alternate. Both signals are rebuilt: neither vendor file is published. Amygdala: this project's rising sweep (6 to 30 Hz) with the published point duration and length, 289 points of 3 ms = 867 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]); the point values were never published. Hippocampus: a primed burst at 3-ms points, one pulse, then four pulses 170 ms later, three times in 0.74 s (after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]). They start together every 4.87 s. Steps of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil are this project's reading of a lecture example with no unit named; no step table of this session is published. One coil stands for each of Shiva's coil pairs and covers half its arc. The vendor lists 20, 30 and 60-min versions: phase 1 alone is the 20-min one, both phases the 30-min one. The vendor gives no number for Shiva's field. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Left-handed or ambidextrous users should start with short sessions and stop on fear, irritability, sadness or anxiety. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed. Murphy reports headaches in about 2% of users of an earlier version, mostly with hippocampal signals: lower the intensity by a third.
